name: GMI Technology Inc.
summary: GMI Technology Inc. functions as a global supplier of electronic components and a developer of application-specific solutions. Its broad product catalog encompasses offerings for consumer electronics, home appliances, IT and networking infrastructure, data and telecommunications, industrial uses, and power management. The company also provides various application solutions, including those for the Internet of Things (IoT), Bluetooth speakers, smart voice control, Android smart TV boxes, automotive Ethernet, SSDs, Type C technology, BLDC range hood systems, and small appliances. Additionally, GMI Technology offers a suite of support services such as marketing, design assistance, Field Application Engineering (FAE), logistics and Vendor-Managed Inventory (VMI), and payment gateway VAT processing. Founded in 1995, the company maintains its main office in Taipei, Taiwan.
